title: M5Stack NanoH2 · C149
summary: 基于ESP32-H2的微型Thread/Zigbee开发板，提供Grove、USB-C、用户按键、RGB与红外发射；本平台尚无H2执行模型。
assemblyNotes: Native assembled components 0 and 2 retained; components 1/3 are Y-translated printing copies. Rotate +90 degrees about Z and center by a rigid translation only, with USB at bottom and Grove at top per dimension drawing. Exterior CAD length is 23.4698mm versus official rounded 23.5mm, within predeclared 0.05mm comparison tolerance.

derivedParts.notes: Visible connector centered in documented end opening. Depth, metal/tongue and z center are photo-informed estimates, not manufacturing CAD or electrical simulation.
Independent transparent decal over the outer paper-bearing face; does not recolor the shell or cover visible mechanical holes. Planar placement is photograph-informed, not a manufacturing label CAD.

Official front/side photos show a continuous white rear socket body down to the front shell edge. Actual molded rear-body dimensions remain unverified.

textureSources.notes: Explicit paper-label alpha ROI in original photograph pixels. Case material, surrounding connector bodies and mechanical holes are excluded. Source lighting/perspective remain uncalibrated.

limitations: Manufacturer exterior CAD only; CPU, display, touch, radio and board-level firmware behavior are unavailable for this product.
Materials are photograph-informed display approximations, not calibrated manufacturer material data.
PCB UNKNOWN is an estimated blank placeholder, excluded from internal 1:1 claims; no inferred chips, copper or manufacturing holes.
No physical device measurements or hardware flashing performed.
PinMap header names ESP32-C6FH4 although SoC specification and product identify ESP32-H2FH4S; no C6 runtime or pin assumptions imported.
Grove and USB visual inserts are estimated from official end views, separate from the two manufacturer shell parts; pin/contact dimensions are not manufacturing-verified.
Paper markings use explicit transparent source-photo masks; unlabelled shell remains a recolorable material. Photo lighting and minor paper placement are not calibrated.
